verdict.rationale: Airwallex supports background automation mainly as building blocks. Recurring invoices and multi-frequency subscriptions bill on a schedule without manual action. The CLI is documented to "script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems," webhooks with retries and redelivery support event-driven pipelines, and AgentOS runs multi-step financial workflows "on your behalf." However, the agentic workflows run inside external agent clients (Claude Code, Cursor) rather than as a native, always-on background service, and money-out actions are off by default. missing for 10: a native scheduler or rules engine for user-defined autonomous agent automations, documentation of unattended or background execution for AgentOS skills, independent or hands-on corroboration.
